gaps.concept: Most congenital adrenal hyperplasias are autosomal recessive; 21-hydroxylase deficiency results from CYP21A2 variants.
gaps.why_tested: A sibling with salt-wasting CAH prompts an inheritance or recurrence-risk question. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1171/)

gaps.concept: StAR transfers cholesterol into mitochondria, the rate-limiting step of steroidogenesis.
gaps.why_tested: A pathway diagram asks what supplies cholesterol to mitochondrial steroid-synthesis enzymes. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5235947/)

gaps.concept: CYP11A1, or cholesterol desmolase, converts cholesterol to pregnenolone, the common precursor of adrenal steroids.
gaps.why_tested: An enzyme-block question asks for the first product formed from cholesterol.

gaps.concept: 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase converts pregnenolone to progesterone, 17-hydroxypregnenolone to 17-hydroxyprogesterone, and DHEA to androstenedione.
gaps.why_tested: A steroid-pathway diagram requires identifying the enzyme connecting precursor pairs.

gaps.concept: 21-hydroxylase converts progesterone to deoxycorticosterone and 17-hydroxyprogesterone to 11-deoxycortisol.
gaps.why_tested: A metabolite pattern asks which blocked reaction causes low mineralocorticoid and cortisol production. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5624825/)

gaps.concept: 11β-hydroxylase converts 11-deoxycortisol to cortisol; elevated 11-deoxycortisol distinguishes its deficiency from 17α-hydroxylase deficiency.
gaps.why_tested: A hypertensive child with CAH has a steroid panel requiring identification of the deficient enzyme. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4976049/)

gaps.concept: Zona glomerulosa lacks 17α-hydroxylase and uses aldosterone synthase, CYP11B2, for the final mineralocorticoid steps.
gaps.why_tested: A zonal enzyme-expression question asks why glomerulosa makes aldosterone but not cortisol.

gaps.concept: Reticularis produces DHEA and DHEA-S, precursors of androstenedione and testosterone.
gaps.why_tested: An adrenal androgen panel or pathway diagram asks for the principal secreted adrenal androgen.

gaps.concept: Fasciculata contains lipid-rich pale cells in straight cords; glomerulosa forms clusters; reticularis has branching cords and lipofuscin.
gaps.why_tested: An adrenal histology image asks which cortical zone is shown. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK278945/)

gaps.concept: Simple virilizing 21-hydroxylase deficiency preserves enough aldosterone to avoid neonatal salt wasting.
gaps.why_tested: A virilized child with normal electrolytes must be distinguished from salt-wasting classic CAH.

gaps.concept: Affected 46,XY newborns with 21-hydroxylase deficiency usually have normal external genitalia and may first present with adrenal crisis.
gaps.why_tested: A male newborn develops vomiting and dehydration after an initially normal examination.

gaps.concept: In 46,XX CAH, the uterus and ovaries remain present despite virilized external genitalia.
gaps.why_tested: Pelvic imaging in an infant with ambiguous genitalia distinguishes adrenal androgen exposure from absent Müllerian structures.

gaps.concept: Excess adrenal androgens cause premature pubic hair, advanced bone age, rapid childhood growth, and reduced adult height.
gaps.why_tested: A child with early androgen effects and advanced skeletal maturation has untreated CAH. [Source](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1171/)

gaps.concept: Cortisol deficiency can cause neonatal hypoglycemia; excess ACTH can cause hyperpigmentation in CAH.
gaps.why_tested: A newborn with salt wasting also has low glucose or darkened skin.

gaps.concept: Salt-wasting 21-hydroxylase deficiency raises plasma renin activity.
gaps.why_tested: A neonatal electrolyte panel includes renin and asks whether mineralocorticoid production is deficient.

gaps.concept: In 11β-hydroxylase deficiency, deoxycorticosterone suppresses renin and usually aldosterone despite mineralocorticoid excess.
gaps.why_tested: A hypertensive, virilized child has low aldosterone, requiring recognition of another mineralocorticoid.

gaps.concept: 17α-hydroxylase deficiency increases deoxycorticosterone and corticosterone, suppressing renin and usually aldosterone.
gaps.why_tested: A hypertensive patient with absent puberty has low aldosterone despite mineralocorticoid effects. [Source](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8070426/)

gaps.concept: High corticosterone in 17α-hydroxylase deficiency supplies glucocorticoid activity, making adrenal crisis uncommon despite low cortisol.
gaps.why_tested: A patient with markedly low cortisol has hypertension without the expected adrenal crisis. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4976049/)

gaps.concept: A 46,XY patient with 17α-hydroxylase deficiency has testes and no uterus because testicular anti-Müllerian hormone remains active.
gaps.why_tested: Imaging of a phenotypically female adolescent with hypertension distinguishes this defect from gonadal dysgenesis.

gaps.concept: Nonclassic 21-hydroxylase deficiency shows elevated basal or ACTH-stimulated 17-hydroxyprogesterone, distinguishing it from PCOS.
gaps.why_tested: A patient with hirsutism and irregular menses needs a discriminating hormone result. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5624825/)

gaps.concept: 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase deficiency causes salt wasting, elevated 17-hydroxypregnenolone and DHEA, and undervirilization of 46,XY infants.
gaps.why_tested: An infant has adrenal insufficiency and atypical genitalia with a precursor pattern unlike 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

gaps.concept: StAR deficiency causes lipoid adrenal hyperplasia with accumulated adrenal cholesterol, severe steroid deficiency, and undervirilization of 46,XY infants.
gaps.why_tested: A newborn with adrenal crisis and enlarged lipid-laden adrenals has a block before pregnenolone formation. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5624825/)

gaps.concept: Metyrapone inhibits 11β-hydroxylase, lowering cortisol and raising 11-deoxycortisol when pituitary ACTH secretion is intact.
gaps.why_tested: A pharmacologic stimulation test asks for the expected steroid response after enzyme inhibition. [Source](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4974254/)

gaps.concept: Abiraterone inhibits CYP17A1, reducing androgen synthesis and causing ACTH-driven mineralocorticoid excess.
gaps.why_tested: A patient receiving prostate-cancer therapy develops hypertension and hypokalemia. [Source](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22170708/)
